trainer.name: Tristan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Tristan: Our eyes met! That means we have to battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Tristan: Aww, my Starly fought hard! You're really tough!

trainer.name: Natalie
trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Natalie: I spy a trainer! That means a battle, please!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Natalie: Wow, you're strong! Jubilife City is just up the road.

trainer.name: Logan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Logan: A battle! Come on! I warn you, though, I'm going to win!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Logan: You beat me? That was fun all the same. I'm going to battle everybody!

youngster.name: Boy
dialog: Trainers on this route challenge you the moment they see you.
If your Pokémon are tired, turn back and rest them in Sandgem Town.

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
A trainer who sees you will want a battle. Pick your path with care if your Pokémon are hurt.
